goal: Pressing Enter on a dashboard row opens a session screen that tail-follows the run's merged audit stream rendered chat-style -- agent text, tool calls with collapsed results, operator say injections, and lifecycle/gate events ordered by sequence -- with scrollback, follow-pause/resume, and a terminal-status banner when the run ends.

relevant: .flywheel/specs/00020-FEATURE-tui-operator-console.md -- FR-3 (Enter/Escape), FR-4, FR-7 session half, and the Edge Cases table are this task's surface
packages/flywheel/src/flywheel/store_protocols.py -- read_audit_since (:432) cursor API for tailing, list_sdk_messages (:416), load_lifecycle (:263)
packages/flywheel/src/flywheel/audit/_cli.py -- the operator-facing read path: record-kind rendering helpers and the on-by-default Redactor wiring to reuse
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_workflow.py -- _summarize_assistant and the _SDK_KIND_LABELS map show how SDK payloads condense to readable lines
references: packages/flywheel/src/flywheel/audit/_cli.py -- mirror its default redaction policy wiring so the session transcript inherits the same best-effort secret suppression the audit surface applies on read
constraints: Tailing is cursor-incremental via read_audit_since: never re-read full history per tick; must stay responsive with 10+ concurrent runs.
Render each message class distinctly: agent text blocks, tool calls (name + key args, collapsed results), operator say injections, lifecycle/gate events; interleave strictly by per-run sequence.
Tail-follow by default; scrolling up pauses follow and shows a new-activity indicator; End resumes follow.
Very large transcript on open: load the most recent window first and lazy-fetch older history on scrollback.
Viewed run reaching a terminal state: the view stays put, shows a terminal-status banner, and keeps the transcript scrollable (FR-7).
AWAITING_APPROVAL runs surface the pending gate instruction prominently on the session screen.
Escape returns to the dashboard with selection preserved; cover navigation and the rendering of each message class with Textual Pilot tests over a seeded store.
Transcript reads pass through the same default Redactor policy the flywheel audit CLI applies on read.
No changes to flywheel core or flywheel-orchestrator beyond what tui-live-rows-seam already exposed.
Run mcp__ide__getDiagnostics on every .py file touched and fix all Pylance errors in the same turn.
Commit with a Conventional Commits feat: message before emitting intent=verify.
non_goals: No steering UI (compose box, interrupt, approve/reject) -- that is tui-steering.
No historical-run browser: only runs in (or lingering past) the active dashboard set are openable.
No new store infrastructure or protocol methods.
edge_cases: New messages arriving while scrolled up must not yank the viewport; the indicator signals activity instead.
A run with zero messages yet renders an empty transcript without error and follows as messages arrive.
